description: This PHP source file manages the Wi-Fi network configuration interface for a gateway device. It includes PHP code to retrieve current Wi-Fi settings via TR-069 or similar mechanisms, and contains extensive embedded JavaScript for dynamically handling user interactions, validating input, and updating configurations through AJAX calls. The file generates the HTML structure for displaying current Wi-Fi settings, allows enabling/disabling radios, editing SSID parameters, managing WPS, and handling band steering features. It appears to be part of a web-based UI for configuring dual-band Wi-Fi settings, security modes, channels, WPS, and band steering options.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends AJAX POST request to update wireless configuration based on user input, then reloads the page upon success.

methods.name: show_extch
methods.description: Displays or hides extension channel options based on selected channel number.

methods.name: check_add
methods.description: Validates user input for adding a device to the MAC filter list, checking name and MAC address formats.

methods.name: adjust_row
methods.description: Reindexes and styles table rows for MAC filtering list display.

methods.name: add_row
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the MAC filtering or auto-learned device list table.

methods.name: del_row
methods.description: Deletes a selected row from the MAC filter list after user confirmation.

methods.name: add_auto
methods.description: Copies an auto-learned device entry into the manual filter list.

methods.name: save_filter
methods.description: Collects and submits the MAC filter list configuration via AJAX.

methods.name: save_config
methods.description: Saves various wireless settings to the device via AJAX.

methods.name: save_enable
methods.description: Saves enable/disable states of radios and WPS settings via AJAX.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates WPS PIN checksum using the standard algorithm.

methods.name: pair_client
methods.description: Initiates WPS pairing process via AJAX with validation.

methods.name: pair_cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing WPS pairing process via AJAX upon user confirmation.

methods.name: showSteeringHistoryDialog
methods.description: Displays the band steering history in a modal dialog.

methods.name: steering_history
methods.description: Loads and displays band steering logs via AJAX into a dialog.

methods.name: saveBandSteeringSettings
methods.description: Saves band steering parameters via AJAX and reloads the page.
